decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:E00 (Dated 04/11/2025),E01 (Dated 27/11/2025),E02 (Dated 27/11/2025),E03 (Dated 27/11/2025),E04 (Dated 27/11/2025),P00 (Dated 26/11/2025),P01 (Dated 02/02/2026),P02 (Dated 02/02/2026),P03 (Dated 02/02/2026),P04 (Dated 02/02/2026),P05 (Dated 02/02/2026),P06 (Dated 02/02/2026),P07 (Dated 26/11/2025),P08 (Dated 26/11/2025),SuDS Proforma,Highway Safety Impact Form.Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area..

The development shall not commence until details of source control SuDS has been submitted and approved by the Local Authority. Source control SuDS measures include green roofs, rain gardens and permeable paving. The details must include plans, specifications and maintenance information. The developer should use the SuDS Proforma for minor developers found on our webpage https://www.enfield.gov.uk/services/planning/sustainable-drainage-systems to assist them through our requirements.Reason: To ensure the sustainable management of water, minimise flood risk, minimise discharge of surface water outside of the curtilage of the property and ensure that the drainage system will remain functional throughout the lifetime of the development

Notwithstanding the details provided within the submitted documents, prior to the first occupation of the HMO hereby permitted, 8 long stay cycle parking spaces to satisfy the permitted number of occupiers on site shall have been fully provided.The dedicated cycle store providing 8 long stay parking spaces shall fulfil the following:-	Have aisles at least 1.5 metres wide to allow for easy manoeuvring.-	Provide a minimum width of at least 1 metre between stands.-	Provide an access door with a minimum width of at least 1.2 metres.-	Be secured with a British Standard mortice lock or access fob to provide greater security.Reason: To ensure that adequate cycle parking facilities are provided to promote sustainable modes of transport.

Notwithstanding the details provided within the submitted documents, prior to the first occupation of the HMO hereby permitted, waste storage and recycling facilities to satisfy the permitted number of occupiers shall have been provided on site.General waste storage shall be provided in the form of a commercial HMO container. There is a weekly hire charge to these containers which will need to be paid and can be ordered through the Council's Commercial Waste team. Recycling facilities shall be provided in accordance with Enfield's Household Recycling and Waste Planning Guidance for New Developments (February 2024), which includes a waste capacity calculator for weekly collection, which shall be used to establish the type and quantity of recycling bins required.Such facilities are to be retained thereafter, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To ensure that adequate waste and recycling storage facilities are provided to meet the needs of future occupiers, promote sustainable waste management practices, and support borough-wide recycling targets.

The HMO hereby permitted shall not be occupied by more than 8 residents at any one time, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  Reason: To ensure that the future occupation of the building does not compromise standards of accommodation and does not adversely affect the residential amenities of neighbouring properties.

No independent cooking or laundry facilities shall be installed in any of the respective bedrooms and the ground floor communal kitchen and dining room, and the first floor communal kitchen shall be retained in perpetuity. Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.
description: Change of use from Use Class C3 (dwelling house) to Use Class Sui Generis (HMO-house in multiple occupation) including part single, part 2-storey side extension, single storey rear extension, conversion of the garage into habitable room, extension to roof at side to form gable end, rear dormer and rooflights to front, with refuse and cycle storage.
